components.name: Two house street arch connector
components.function: Existing cottage kits cover forest adaptation, not original attached-village street buildings
components.construction: One source village two house street arch connector, cream walls, timber and blue/slate roofs, attached houses with actual open passages rather than isolated forest cottages. Show rear and roof/street contacts; roof corners/door placement follow original village. No huge palace turrets.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
